'''Terr Taneel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from the [[Elder Houses|Elder House]] of [[House Taneel]], who represented the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Considered progressive despite her home [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] outdated culture, she was a member of first the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] and later the [[Delegation of 2000]], concerned with the continued abuse of executive power by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Biography==
===Representative of the Senex sector===
Taneel was a member of the powerful [[House Taneel]],<ref name="TEA" /> hailing from [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]],<ref name="DB" /> her house's homeworld. Her house was considered one of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]]'s most progressive [[Elder Houses]], often tasked with negotiations with outsiders.<ref name="TEA" /> As such, Taneel served as the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]'s [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and was touted for being remarkbly progressive despite the rest of her [[Sector/Legends|sector]]  being perceived as culturally outdated.<ref name="DB" />

Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she served on the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]], organized by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to provide guidance concerning the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="LoE date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> around the time of Taneel's appointment the Committee, it consisted primarily of Senators who opposed the Chancellor's methods of waging the war as well as the Senate's continuing compliance with his wishes.<ref name="LoE" /> Despite her position on that committee, Taneel was aware of Palpatine's [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|constitutional]] abuses, leading her to align herself with Senators such as [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

===Meeting with the Chancellor===
{{Dialogue|Organa|No one is implying that the Supreme Chancellor has been anything but tireless in his... devotion. But the fact remains that he agreed to see us, and we're not about to leave here until he honors his pledge.|Taneel|We're not asking for much of his time.|Pestage|Maybe not, but you must realize how busy he is. What with new developments occurring daily.|attr=Bail Organa and Terr Taneel speak with Sate Pestage in an attempt to meet with the Chancellor|src=<ref name="LoE" />}}
[[File:SenateGreetingParty.png|250px|thumb|left|Taneel was among the Senators to greet Palpatine upon his safe return to the Senate after the Battle of Coruscant.]]
Simultaneous with the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Battle of Cato Neimoidia]]<ref name="LoE" /> in 19 BBY,<ref name="LoE date" /> Taneel met with other members of Palpatine's [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] for a meeting with the Chancellor in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], planned three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] prior. However, they were first waylaid by Palpatine's [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], who claimed to be ignorant of the meeting and stated that Palpatine was busy. Taneel attempted to placate Pestage, stating that they would not take up much of Palpatine's [[Time/Legends|time]], but Pestage refused them access. Ultimately, they remained within the reception area of Palpatine's [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|office]] until Palpatine himself arrived to let them in.<ref name="LoE" />

In the meeting, Organa led the discussion, proposing that the Chancellor rescind some of his executive powers named to him in the interest of public safety earlier in the war, specifically the [[Enhanced Security and Enforcement Act]]. Due to recent victories by the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|army]], the Senators hoped he would aquiesce to their requests, but Palpatine believed that the war, particularly the ongoing [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], was not near a conclusion. Despite this, he agreed to Organa's request that a measure to repeal the Security Act would be introduced to the Senate.<ref name="LoE" />

After the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Taneel was among the Senators who greeted Palpatine following his rescue aboard the ''[[Invisible Hand/Legends|Invisible Hand]]'', [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. Taneel stood beside Senator [[Malé-Dee/Legends|Malé-Dee]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> of [[Uyter/Legends|Uyter]], another Senator suspicious of Palpatine's growing power.<ref name="MaleDee DB">{{DB|character|maledee|Malé-Dee}}</ref> Taneel eventually became a member of the [[Delegation of 2000]], who wished to curb Palpatine's use of emergency powers and open up peace talks with the Confederacy. To this end, members of the Delegation signed the [[Petition of 2000]] which was sent to Palpatine's desk.<ref name="Who's Who" />

===Intrigue in the last days of the Republic===
[[File:TaneelandHalliikeenovich.png|thumb|right|Taneel spoke to her suitor Són Halliikeenovich at the Galaxies Opera House.]]
Following Palpatine's [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], Taneel was invited by Senators Organa and Mothma to a meeting with other likeminded Senators [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]], and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], where they discussed Palpatine's increasing powers, likening him to a [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictator]]. Mothma and Organa began building an organization in secret, swearing the other four Senators to secrecy.<ref name="ROTS novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

Within the Delegation of 2,000, Taneel became close friends with fellow Senator [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]], whom she felt was too impetuous and naïve for their conspiracy. Taneel was protective but also wary of Papanoida.<ref name="DB" /> Near the end of the war, Taneel was courted by [[Són Halliikeenovich]], a member of the lesser noble house of [[House Halliikeenovich]] in the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]]. Halliikeenovich hoped to strengthen House Halliikeenovich as well as House Taneel.<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> To this end, Taneel and Halliikeenovich both attended a showing of the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[Squid Lake]]'' at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the Battle of Coruscant. Taneel and Halliikeenovich were conversing outside of Chancellor Palpatine's [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private box]] in the opera house when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past them to meet with Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" />

Taneel later became an instrumental figure in the creation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref>{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Saga Collection|pack=Lucas Collector's Set|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TSClucascollectorset.asp}}</ref> which was in part created by the work of Organa and Mothma within the Delegation of 2000.<ref name="ROTS novelization" />

==Personality and traits==
Taneel, a Human, had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|216|Taneel, Terr}}</ref> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="DB" />

Despite being raised in a cloistered society considered culturally outdated and inward-looking, Taneel was seen as a progressive in the Senate.<ref name="DB" /> She saw herself as above the hereditary infighting of the Senex [[Lord/Legends|lords]], and was proudly idealist in her beliefs.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Taneel was considered the "cream of the Senate" by some, including Anakin Skywalker, with a reputation of being incorruptible. Taneel agreed to keep her meetings with Organa and Mothma completely secret without protest.<ref name="ROTS novelization" />

==Equipment==
Taneel often<ref name="CSWE" /> wore flowing Senatorial<ref name="ROTSVD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] gowns and a pair of fashionable translation devices on her [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="CSWE" /> While attending the opera, Taneel wore a black dress and a large [[Hat/Legends|headpiece]],<ref name="ROTS" /> which she also wore in the Senate at some point.<ref name="Dressing a Galaxy">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Terr Taneel first appeared in the novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' by [[James Luceno]],<ref name="LoE" /> released on [[January 25]], [[2005]]<ref name="LoE release date">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=18222|text=James Luceno}}</ref> which served as a direct prequel to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="LoE" /> Taneel was first pictured in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="ROTSVD" /> released on [[April 2]] of that year,<ref name="ROTSVD release date">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> which revealed her appearance in the film itself.<ref name="ROTS" />

In [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], Taneel was portrayed by director [[George Lucas]]' eldest daughter, [[Amanda Lucas]]. In April [[2003]], George Lucas discussed with the costume designer [[Trisha Biggar]] the need for four female Senatorial outfits, including one for Amanda and another for her sister [[Katie Lucas|Katie]].<ref name="DB" /> Ultimately, Katie was given the part of [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and Amanda the part of Terr Taneel.<ref name="Insider 125">{{InsiderCite|125|Classic Moment|Classic Moment: The Tragedy of Darth Plagueis}}</ref>
